description: Source code for managing cookies in a TR-069 protocol implementation, including functions for initializing, cleaning, building from headers, and converting cookie jars to string representations.

classes.name: cookie_t
classes.description: Structure representing a cookie with name, value, and list iterator.

methods.name: delete_cookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie from the list and frees associated memory.

methods.name: search_cookie
methods.description: Searches for a cookie by name within a cookie jar.

methods.name: add_cookie
methods.description: Adds a new cookie to the jar with specified name and value.

methods.name: update_cookie
methods.description: Updates the value of an existing cookie.

methods.name: cwmpd_cookie_cookiejar_clean
methods.description: Cleans up and deletes all cookies in a jar.

methods.name: cwmpd_cookie_cookiejar_build
methods.description: Builds cookies from a Set-Cookie header string into the jar.

methods.name: cwmpd_cookie_cookiejar_to_string
methods.description: Converts the cookie jar to a string suitable for HTTP headers.
